biografie.anwalt.vorteil: You know the judiciary and chose well for the justice ministry (+10 ability); former clients owe you favours (+3 capital).
biografie.arzt.preis: On budget matters you rely on the finance minister; his weight and ambition grow (+6).
biografie.arzt.vorteil: People trust a doctor: your staff follows you (+6 loyalty).
biografie.bauunternehmer.preis: The opposition smells conflicts of interest (ambition +3).
biografie.bauunternehmer.vorteil: Contracts and contacts (+3 capital, economy minister +4).
biografie.ehrgeiz.preis: Your staff fears you (−5), the ministers smell opportunity (ambition +3).
biografie.familienbetrieb.vorteil: The economy ministry stands behind you (+5).
biografie.journalistin.preis: A journalist at home: interior ministry −3.
biografie.korruption.preis: Partners who live off contracts turn cool (−4 loyalty).
biografie.krankenpfleger.preis: The opposition turns his work at the hospital into a story about the health system (ambition +3).
biografie.krankenpfleger.vorteil: Your staff keeps you grounded (+3 loyalty).
biografie.moscheegemeinde.vorteil: Religious partners stick with you (+3 loyalty).
biografie.oekonom.vorteil: You understand the numbers and chose the finance minister well (+10); the central bank trusts an expert (+5).
biografie.richterin.preis: An opinion of her own at the kitchen table: polarisation +1.
biografie.sportverein.preis: All ministers see themselves as equals (ambition +3).
biografie.studentenbewegung.vorteil: Young people stand closer to you (+1).
biografie.unglueck.preis: The construction industry keeps its distance (economy minister −3 loyalty).
biografie.unternehmer.preis: The opposition digs through your tax assessment (ambition +5, trust −1).
biografie.unternehmer.vorteil: You know business and chose well for the economy ministry (+10 ability).
biografie.wahl_erste.preis: The cabinet feels like equals (ambition +4), the opposition closes ranks (+4).
biografie.wahl_klar.preis: The partners think they are indispensable (loyalty −5).
biografie.wahl_knapp.vorteil: The partners close ranks (+6) and a war chest (+8 capital).
konfigurator.eigene_hinweis: Drag the sliders: every position has its price.
konfigurator.fussnote: No line is better than another: governing with your line is cheaper, governing against it costs capital, votes and loyalty. A change of course is possible, but expensive.
konfigurator.kurz_hinweis: The abbreviation needs 2 to 5 characters and must not match that of an existing party (AKP, CHP, MHP, DEM …).
konfigurator.name: Party name
konfigurator.voreinstellungen: Presets from one edge to the other
linie.achse.gesellschaft.name: Society
linie.achse.national.name: Nation and world
linie.achse.religion.name: Religion
linie.achse.wirtschaft.name: Economy
linie.achse.zentral.name: State structure
linie.hinweis.gegen: This goes against your party's line: {prozent}% more expensive; partners with a different line partly refuse to vote and grow cooler.
linie.hinweis.mit: This fits your party's line: {prozent}% cheaper, and partners with a similar line vote together.
linie.kurswechsel.gleich: The new line is hardly different from the old one.
linie.kurswechsel.kein_spiel: Without a running game there is no line to change.
linie.kurswechsel.log: The party adopts a new line (cost {kosten} capital, credibility −{strafe}).
linie.kurswechsel.warum: Whoever changes the line loses with the base and with partners of the old line; afterwards the new line is cheaper and the old one more expensive.
linie.kurswechsel.zu_teuer: The change of course costs {kosten} capital; that is too much.
linie.preset.autoritaer.name: Party of Order
linie.preset.autoritaer.text: A strong state, a firm hand, little room for opposition and the press.
linie.preset.gerechtigkeit.name: Social Justice Party
linie.preset.gerechtigkeit.text: Wages, pensions, housing: for everyone who runs out of money before the end of the month.
linie.preset.gruen.name: Green Progressive Party
linie.preset.gruen.text: Climate, participation, an open society: a social and ecological transformation.
linie.preset.islamistisch.name: Islamic Social Party
linie.preset.islamistisch.text: A religious order in the state, social welfare, priority for the community.
linie.preset.konservativ.name: Conservative People's Party
linie.preset.konservativ.text: Preserve what has proved itself: family, order, a sound economy, cautious reform.
linie.preset.kurdisch.name: Federal People's Party
linie.preset.kurdisch.text: Regional autonomy, minority rights, a federal state.
linie.preset.laizistisch.name: Secular Republican Party
linie.preset.laizistisch.text: A strict separation of state and religion, a strong republican state.
linie.preset.liberal.name: Liberal Party
linie.preset.liberal.text: Open markets, civil rights, closer ties with Europe.
linie.preset.libertaer.name: Libertarian Freedom Party
linie.preset.libertaer.text: A small state, low taxes, maximum personal freedom.
linie.preset.mitte.name: Renewal Party
linie.preset.mitte.text: The economy, the rule of law, less quarrelling: for everyone tired of the culture war.
linie.preset.nationalistisch.name: National Unity Party
linie.preset.nationalistisch.text: Sovereignty, a strong army, the nation state above all.
linie.preset.regionen.name: Regions Party
linie.preset.regionen.text: More money and more powers for the provinces, less Ankara.
linie.preset.sozialistisch.name: Socialist Left
linie.preset.sozialistisch.text: A state economy, redistribution, strong unions: property serves the community.
linie.preset.technokratisch.name: Order and Progress Party
linie.preset.technokratisch.text: Experts and the army run the country: efficiency before party politics.
linie.preset.werte.name: Values Party
linie.preset.werte.text: Family, faith, honest work: conservative, but clean.
linie.stamm.minus: Your core voters resent the change of course (approval −{punkte}).
linie.stamm.plus: Your core voters reward you for staying true to your line (approval +{punkte}).
linie.stamm.warum: Governing with your line keeps the base; breaking it costs credibility. The same rule applies to every line from left to right.
prolog.aussehen.hinweis: This is how the country sees you: your face will appear later in office, on election night and in the newspaper.
prolog.band.titel: The stations of your life story
prolog.buendnis.label: Alliance with the {partei}
prolog.buendnis.text: {naehe, select, nah {A party close to your line: much in common, little friction.} mittel {A party with a mind of its own: a marriage of convenience.} other {A party far from your line: many votes, but constant friction.}} Its leadership expects influence and posts.
prolog.buendnis.versprechen: The {partei} was promised influence and posts.
prolog.ende: Election night is over. Tomorrow morning the desk in Ankara is waiting.
prolog.ende_andere: Tomorrow morning the desk in Ankara is waiting.
prolog.folgen_titel: What your biography means (advantage and price)
prolog.ich.einleitung: It is spring 2028. In a few weeks Turkey will elect a new parliament and a new president. Before we get there, tell us who you are and how you got here.
prolog.st.beruf.anwalt.label: Lawyer
prolog.st.beruf.anwalt.text: Contracts, courts, clients who still owe you favours.
prolog.st.beruf.arzt.label: Doctor
prolog.st.beruf.arzt.text: Night shifts in a provincial clinic. You know what the health system lacks.
prolog.st.beruf.oekonom.label: Economist
prolog.st.beruf.oekonom.text: Ten years at a bank, then at the university. You understand interest rates; voters less so.
prolog.st.beruf.question: How did you earn your living?
prolog.st.beruf.story: Before you gave speeches, you worked. People know it, and so do your opponents.
prolog.st.beruf.title: Career
prolog.st.beruf.unternehmer.label: Entrepreneur
prolog.st.beruf.unternehmer.text: A company with three hundred employees. And a tax assessment the press would love to see.
prolog.st.jugend.betrieb.label: The family business
prolog.st.jugend.betrieb.text: You learned what a payslip is before you were old enough to vote.
prolog.st.jugend.moschee.label: The mosque community
prolog.st.jugend.moschee.text: Youth group, summer camp, an imam who taught you to listen.
prolog.st.jugend.question: What shaped you?
prolog.st.jugend.sport.label: The sports club
prolog.st.jugend.sport.text: Captain of the youth team. You know how to hold a dressing room together.
prolog.st.jugend.story: At seventeen you had opinions about everything and experience of nothing.
prolog.st.jugend.studenten.label: The student movement
prolog.st.jugend.studenten.text: Leaflets, late-night arguments, an arrest you smile about today.
prolog.st.jugend.title: Youth
prolog.st.kindheit.diyarbakir.label: Diyarbakır
prolog.st.kindheit.diyarbakir.text: An old city in the southeast, with many languages and many wounds.
prolog.st.kindheit.izmir.label: İzmir
prolog.st.kindheit.izmir.text: A big city by the sea, open to the world and loud.
prolog.st.kindheit.konya.label: Konya
prolog.st.kindheit.konya.text: A city in central Anatolia: devout, hard-working, proud.
prolog.st.kindheit.question: Where did you grow up?
prolog.st.kindheit.story: Every career starts somewhere. Yours started in a kitchen where politics was argued over in the evenings.
prolog.st.kindheit.title: Childhood
prolog.st.kindheit.trabzon.label: Trabzon
prolog.st.kindheit.trabzon.text: A port on the Black Sea: football, tea and stubborn heads.
prolog.st.liebe.demo.label: At a demonstration
prolog.st.liebe.demo.text: You were hit by the same water cannon. She is a journalist today.
prolog.st.liebe.hochzeit.label: At a wedding
prolog.st.liebe.hochzeit.text: The families helped along. He now runs his father's construction company.
prolog.st.liebe.hoersaal.label: In the lecture hall
prolog.st.liebe.hoersaal.text: She was smarter than you and let you know it every day. Today she is a judge.
prolog.st.liebe.klinik.label: In the hospital
prolog.st.liebe.klinik.text: He was a nurse, you were the patient. He keeps your feet on the ground to this day.
prolog.st.liebe.question: How did you meet your partner?
prolog.st.liebe.story: There are people you meet, and people who happen to you.
prolog.st.liebe.title: Love
prolog.st.partei.question: What does your party stand for?
prolog.st.partei.story: The old parties were too narrow, too tired or too busy with themselves. So you founded a new one.
prolog.st.partei.title: Your own party
prolog.st.politik.ehrgeiz.label: Ambition
prolog.st.politik.ehrgeiz.text: You simply wanted it. At least you are honest with yourself.
prolog.st.politik.korruption.label: Anger at corruption
prolog.st.politik.korruption.text: You saw how contracts are handed out. And who gets them.
prolog.st.politik.mentor.label: A mentor
prolog.st.politik.mentor.text: An old mayor took you along on his campaign tour. Today he is your sharpest critic.
prolog.st.politik.question: What brought you into politics?
prolog.st.politik.story: Nobody goes into politics looking for a quiet evening.
prolog.st.politik.title: The road into politics
prolog.st.politik.unglueck.label: A disaster
prolog.st.politik.unglueck.text: A building collapsed in your home town. The builder got off with a fine.
prolog.st.wahlkampf.allein_gross.label: Alone, with a big promise
prolog.st.wahlkampf.allein_gross.text: No alliance. Instead the promise: pensions up within the first hundred days.
prolog.st.wahlkampf.allein_hart.label: Alone, with a hard promise
prolog.st.wahlkampf.allein_hart.text: No alliance. Instead: every large contract is made public, every minister discloses their wealth.
prolog.st.wahlkampf.mhp.label: Alliance with the MHP
prolog.st.wahlkampf.mhp.text: The nationalists bring votes in Anatolia and want a hard line on security.
prolog.st.wahlkampf.question: Do you enter an electoral alliance, and what do you promise?
prolog.st.wahlkampf.story: Eighteen months of rallies, bad tea, good polls and one question every adviser asks you.
prolog.st.wahlkampf.title: The 2028 campaign
prolog.st.wahlkampf.yeni.label: Alliance with the YENİ Party
prolog.st.wahlkampf.yeni.text: Strong against the government, but its leadership expects ministries.
prolog.st.wahlnacht.erste.label: In the first round
prolog.st.wahlnacht.erste.text: 51.2 percent in the very first round. Nobody expected it, you didn't either.
prolog.st.wahlnacht.klar.label: Clearly in the runoff
prolog.st.wahlnacht.klar.text: 54 percent. A clear mandate, but after two rounds of voting.
prolog.st.wahlnacht.knapp.label: Narrowly in the runoff
prolog.st.wahlnacht.knapp.text: 50.6 percent. Half the country did not want you, and says so loudly.
prolog.st.wahlnacht.question: How did you win?
prolog.st.wahlnacht.story: It is just after midnight. The projections swing, your phone is glowing, your family is asleep on the sofa.
prolog.st.wahlnacht.title: Election night
prolog.szenario.einleitung: The story can start from scratch, in the middle of a term, or after a crash. Your choice decides what baggage you start with.
prolog.vorschau.nichts: No fixed consequence: this answer only colours your story.
prolog.zusammenfassung.neugruendung: {partei} · elected {gang, select, erste {in the first round} other {in the runoff}} with {anteil, number}%
prolog.zusammenfassung.regierungspartei: {partei} · takes office in the middle of the legislature
prolog.zusammenfassung.uebergang: {partei} · leads the caretaker government after the crisis
start.krise.log: The crisis has hit prices and the currency: inflation is high, the lira is weak, risk premiums have risen.
start.krise.warum: The balance sheet measures from this starting point. Crisis blockers are active: some projects are blocked or more expensive until the situation calms.
start.log.regierungspartei: {name} takes over the leadership of the {partei} and the presidency in the middle of the legislature. The party holds {eigene} of 600 seats, the governing bloc with its partners {bloc}.
start.log.uebergang: {name} leads a caretaker government after the crisis as the {partei}. The party holds {eigene} of 600 seats, the governing bloc {bloc}.
start.neugruendung.name: A new party
start.neugruendung.text: A new party wins the 2028 election. Everything is open; partners and opponents follow from your line.
start.opposition.name: Opposition after a change of power
start.opposition.status: Coming later: needs the opposition phase in the game.
start.opposition.text: You lead the opposition, prepare the next election and wait for your chance.
start.regierungspartei.name: Take over the governing party
start.regierungspartei.text: You take over the party and office of the previous government in the middle of the legislature: an existing parliament, an alliance with the MHP and your predecessors' legacy with two open promises. The next election is a little over two and a half years away.
start.uebergang.name: Caretaker government after the crisis
start.uebergang.text: A price and currency crisis has brought down the government. You lead a caretaker government; the election is a little over a year away, the economy is at the brink and crisis blockers are active.
